tool_args.rationale: All available observations share one horizon and prior compact branch mechanisms failed fresh confirmation. Their response varies smoothly with the jointly changing u_now and s_grad, so use a numerically fitted low-order joint response surface as a parsimonious empirical alternative. Fresh confirmation will determine whether this stationary approximation meets tolerance.
